disposition_reason: INAA rubidium in transitional breast milk from 40 Iranian mothers: mean, median, SD, min and max on a dry weight basis, plus 40 individual values.

study.method: instrumental neutron activation analysis; HPGe gamma spectrometry after 30 to 38 days decay
study.qa: Reference material B01 (apple leaves, Esfahan Nuclear Technology Center); recovery not reported

findings.group: 40 mothers, Mashhad, Iran, 3 to 15 days postpartum
findings.reported: 32.176 ppm dry weight (SD 21.193; median 28.195; min 8.660; max 107.210)
findings.notes: ppm taken as mg/kg; x1000 to ug/kg. SD 21.193 ppm = 21,193 ug/kg. Table 1 minimum is 8.659 ppm.

non_numeric_findings: Rubidium did not correlate with maternal age or weight or with newborn weight, age or sex (Findings, p. 694).
